jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Labs
jobs.reason: This is a senior leadership role (Associate Director managing a data science team) requiring PhD-level research experience plus deep applied-NLP expertise — transformer fine-tuning, LLM engineering, cloud compute management — none of which the candidate (analysis-level Python, no ML/engineering, MSc-in-progress, no management) possesses. The PhD requirement and senior management title are hard ineligibilities, and the substantive work is general-public behavioural data science, not the candidate's policy/IR profile.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: International law and accountability work is core to the candidate's profile, but a "Senior" legal adviser role requires a qualified lawyer and substantial experience, neither of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on seniority and likely qualifying-law-degree requirement.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board seat is a senior, expert-level appointment requiring extensive standing in international law — far beyond the candidate's MSc-in-progress stage. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Internship - Speculative Opportunities
jobs.reason: Although the field and level fit well, this is an explicitly speculative internship with no concrete advertised vacancy — excluded under the speculative/open-application rule.

jobs.title: IT Officer
jobs.reason: An IT support/operations role is outside the candidate's research/policy profile despite the organisation's relevant mission. Field mismatch.

jobs.title: IT Security Officer
jobs.reason: IT security operations is a technical infrastructure role unrelated to the candidate's research/policy background, and not the policy/OSINT side of zone-c. Field mismatch.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
jobs.reason: This is an explicit talent-pool/speculative application with no concrete advertised vacancy — excluded under the speculative/open-application rule.

jobs.title: Technical Specialist, Claude Code
jobs.reason: This is a customer-facing technical sales/solutions-engineering role requiring 5–7+ years of professional software-engineering and developer-relations experience — a hard ineligibility on both seniority and skills. The work (shipping production demos, live-coding, solutions architecture) is deep-technical software engineering far outside the candidate's analysis-level Python and policy-research profile.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Contemporary Strategy
jobs.reason: War Studies / strategic studies is squarely core to the candidate's field, but this is a permanent Lecturer post requiring an established publication track record, ability to secure external funding and to supervise PhD students — effectively presupposing a completed PhD and academic-faculty experience the MSc-stage candidate does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Academic Planning and Quality Assurance Officer (AD07)
jobs.reason: Higher education quality assurance and academic planning is on-profile (the candidate has HE policy/research-administration experience), but the role requires at least 5 years of HE work experience in curriculum development — a hard experience bar the candidate cannot meet. Seniority fails decisively.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Financial Advisory
jobs.reason: This is an executive-assistant / administrative support role in financial advisory, not a policy, research or intelligence function — off the candidate's profile despite Teneo's relevance in geopolitical risk. It requires extensive prior EA experience supporting senior leaders, which the candidate lacks, and the work itself is unrelated to their research strengths.
